question: Should ClawHub sponsor the staged signed catalog-distribution protocol, including this sharded-snapshot slice, before its three open prerequisite PRs and the OpenClaw consumer are independently proven and reviewed?
rationale: The patch creates a new public distribution protocol and operator signing configuration; choosing its long-term rollout and consumer-compatibility commitment requires repository product and release ownership rather than a mechanical contributor repair.

options.title: Sponsor staged rollout
options.body: Review and merge the prerequisite slices in order after live proof confirms unsigned compatibility and signed consumer verification, keeping production signing dormant until the consumer trust anchor is ready.

options.title: Narrow the protocol
options.body: Request a smaller, independently deployable producer capability before accepting shards, queries, changes, and signing as one coordinated rollout.

options.title: Defer distribution work
options.body: Pause the feed-stack proposal until maintainers explicitly prioritize hosted signed catalog distribution and assign an owner for activation.

recommendation.title: Sponsor staged rollout
recommendation.body: Review and merge the prerequisite slices in order after live proof confirms unsigned compatibility and signed consumer verification, keeping production signing dormant until the consumer trust anchor is ready.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor is the only evidence-backed owner of all four related feed-stack slices in the supplied history, though final product acceptance belongs to repository leadership.
